rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2010).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2010 as 'Not Simply Pink'.
rows.Bloom: None / no fragrance. 40 petals. Very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
